description: Land Acquisition - Ransegoda, Mulatiyana D/S Division, Matara District
categorisation: This gazette content is a Land Acquisition Notice published under the Land Acquisition Act. It specifically declares that a particular land parcel is needed for public purpose and will be acquired. The content describes the land location, boundaries, and extent in detail, making it primarily about land and property matters, which falls under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4). While it mentions a Minister by name, this is incidental to the land acquisition declaration rather than being the primary focus of the gazette.
